SourceFile
  RootPackage
  fun main()
    try
      throw
        Call ArithmeticException
    catch e: UnwrapException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "unwrap"
    catch e: ArithmeticException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "arith"
    catch e: Exception
      Call println
        StringLiteral "generic"
    finally
      Call println
        StringLiteral "done"
